agent-process-ledger: upstream #21299 adds `AgentScope.stop`/`AgentScopeCommand.unit` and stops each agent's systemd scope when the process it launched exits (Claude's group watcher, ACP runtimes, Pi, Muse). It reaps `setsid` descendants outside the process group, so it complements the fork's POSIX-group ledger rather than replacing it. Pi spawns again to apply a compaction point in the same scope, so its exit watch moved inside `spawnConnection` (one per connection) and `prepareCompactionPoint` interrupts the old watch before terminating, or the stop would disable the process it just started

managed-delegation: upstream #23886 (Stop stops a thread's subagents again) is one line where it meets the fork, `stopDelegatedTasks: false` on the cancel-task `thread.stop`; the fork's delivery dispose, queued-run cancel and dispatch-mode limit are unchanged. Its ThreadStop test expects a repeated Stop to write no event, and the fork's stop path broke that twice: `markStoppedBackgroundWork` re-recorded work the run already named, and `disposeDelegatedCompletionCohort` re-emitted a cohort the first Stop had settled. Both now emit only when the payload would change, so the test stands as upstream wrote it

compact-line: upstream #24008 stops a typed `/compact` with instructions queueing a bare compaction first (`COMPACT_COMMAND_PATTERN`); the fork's per-thread point and Pi's settings write are untouched

perf-persistence-reads: upstream #23987 adds `ProjectionStore.listActiveSubagentThreadIds` so a shell subscription no longer reads every thread's shell on resume; it is wrapped in `readOnReader` like the other projection reads

slipjay-delivery-config: upstream's #23581 `check:changed` rewrite (side-by-side steps, a result cache keyed on the checked tree, unused-patch install check, `core.quotePath=false`) adopted; the fork's `slipjay.json` integration-branch default is the only deviation left in the file

web-client-customisation and subagent-return-chip: upstream #23752's activity announcer mounts in both the empty and filled timeline in `MessagesTimeline.tsx`, which keeps the fork's eased follow (`endPinSuppressed`/`glidesToEnd`, `size: !glidesToEnd`) and therefore drops upstream's `settlingListIdentity`/`TIMELINE_MAINTAIN_SCROLL_AT_END_SMOOTH` conditional it replaced; #23739, #23776, #24032, #24063 and #24036 adopted unchanged, the blockquote rule being upstream's own (the composer override that went with it was upstream's too)
